name: Labneh
description: Thick strained yogurt eaten with zaatar and oil.

unani.note: Follows laban's cooling nature in Arab usage.

nutrition.highlight: yogurt with the water strained out

guna.note: Soured and cultured dairy is read as heavier than fresh milk, and traditionally avoided at night.

effects.note: Labneh is yogurt strained further still, carrying the same live cultures that let yogurt digest some of its own lactose before it reaches a lactase-poor gut — the underlying trials tested plain yogurt rather than labneh itself, but this is the same product, concentrated, not a different one. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
